 ----end----

PROCEDURE donor_since IS
v_donation date;
v_aux_don date;
BEGIN
 /* To select donor since*/
 begin
 begin
 select min(coll_date) into v_donation
 from donations
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 begin
 select min(coll_date) into v_aux_don
 from aux_donations
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;

 if v_donation is not null and v_aux_don is null then
 :donors.donor_since := v_donation;
 elsif v_donation is null and v_aux_don is not null then
 :donors.donor_since := v_aux_don;
 elsif v_donation is not null and v_aux_don is not null then
 if v_donation <= v_aux_don then
 :donors.donor_since := v_donation;
 else
 :donors.donor_since := v_aux_don;
 end if;
 elsif v_donation is null and v_aux_don is null then
 :donors.donor_since := '';
 end if;
 end;
/* To find no of years */

 :donors.donor_year := to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') - to_char(:donors.donor_since, 'YYYY');

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DONOR_PLASMA_RBC_LOSS(p_donor_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_donor_weight in NUMBER,
 p_chapter_id IN varchar2) IS

 
 
 CURSOR cur_rbc_days (pl_local_date in date ) is select maximum_loss,days_between from
 valid_elig_cell_loss where cell_type='RBC' and
 pl_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date , Pl_local_date+10);



 
 CURSOR cur_plasma_days (pl_donor_weight in number, pl_local_date in date ) is select maximum_loss,days_between from
 valid_elig_cell_loss where cell_type='PLASM' and pl_donor_weight between from_weight and to_weight and
 pl_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date , Pl_local_date+10);


 

 CURSOR cur_rbc_loss(p_local_date in date, pl_days_between in number) is select actual_rbc_loss,
 donation_type, procedure_code from donations where
 donor_id=p_donor_id and unit_id is not null and
 coll_date between (p_local_date-pl_days_between) and p_local_date;

 

 CURSOR cur_plasma_loss(p_local_date in date, pl_days_between in number) is select actual_plasma_loss,
 donation_type, procedure_code from donations where
 donor_id=p_donor_id and unit_id is not null and
 coll_date between (p_local_date-pl_days_between) and p_local_date;


 cum_rbc_loss NUMBER:=0;
 cum_plasma_loss NUMBER:=0;
 s_rbc_loss NUMBER:=0;
 s_plasma_loss NUMBER:=0;
 e_rbc_loss NUMBER:=0;
 e_plasma_loss NUMBER:=0;
 v_local_date date;
 v_days_between NUMBER;
 
BEGIN

 v_local_date:=Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id,sysdate);
 
 go_block('cell_loss_display');
 first_record;
 
 -- Populate RBC loss
 
 For rbc_days_rec in cur_rbc_days(v_local_date) LOOP
 
 v_days_between:=rbc_days_rec.days_between;
 cum_rbc_loss:=0;
 s_rbc_loss:=0;
 e_rbc_loss:=0;
 

 FOR Z in CUR_RBC_LOSS(v_local_date,v_days_between) loop

 
 select STANDARD_RBC_LOSS , ECV_RBC_LOSS into s_rbc_loss,
 e_rbc_loss from valid_proc_codes where
 procedure_code=Z.procedure_code and
 v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1);
 
 cum_rbc_loss:=cum_rbc_loss + nvl(Z.actual_rbc_loss,(s_rbc_loss+e_rbc_loss));
 END LOOP;
 
 :cell_loss_display.cell_type:='RBC';
 :cell_loss_display.days_between:=v_days_between;
 :cell_loss_display.loss:=cum_rbc_loss;
 
 next_record;
 End loop;
 
 
 
 -- Populate plasma loss
 
 For plasma_days_rec in cur_plasma_days(p_donor_weight,v_local_date) LOOP
 
 v_days_between:=plasma_days_rec.days_between;
 
 cum_plasma_loss:=0;
 s_plasma_loss:=0;
 e_plasma_loss:=0;
 

 FOR Z in CUR_PLASMA_LOSS(v_local_date,v_days_between) loop

 
 select STANDARD_PLASMA_LOSS , ECV_PLASMA_LOSS into s_plasma_loss,
 e_plasma_loss from valid_proc_codes where
 procedure_code=Z.procedure_code and
 v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1);
 
 
 cum_plasma_loss:=cum_plasma_loss + nvl(Z.actual_plasma_loss,
 (s_plasma_loss+e_plasma_loss));
 END LOOP;
 
 :cell_loss_display.cell_type:='PLASMA';
 :cell_loss_display.days_between:=v_days_between;
 :cell_loss_display.loss:=cum_plasma_loss;
 
 next_record;
 End loop;

 go_item('button_block.pn_cancel');
 
 set_item_property('cell_loss_display.cell_type',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('cell_loss_display.cell_type',update_allowed,property_false);
 
 go_block('cell_loss_display');
 

 FIRST_RECORD;
 
END DONOR_PLASMA_RBC_LOSS;
